parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The region in which the service resides.

parameters.name: Expire
parameters.description: The period of time for which the URL expires.

parameters.name: Internal
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the VPC connection.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The page type.

Valid values:

*   webview
*   monitor

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas describe-service-signed-url --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --service-name foo --type webview --expire 43200 --internal false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/services/cn-hangzhou/foo/signed_url --region cn-hangzhou --Type webview --Expire 43200 --Internal false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
